job_categories.name: Audio Electrical Engineering
job_categories.description: Analog and digital circuit design for audio hardware. Roles involve PCB layout, amplifier design, mixed-signal circuits, power supplies, and integrating electronic components for consumer and professional audio devices.

job_categories.name: Transducer Engineering
job_categories.description: Physical design of electroacoustic transducers — loudspeakers, headphone drivers, earbud drivers, and acoustic chambers. Involves mechanics, materials, magnets, voice coils, acoustic simulation, and transducer characterization.

job_categories.name: Microphones & Recording Technology
job_categories.description: Microphone design, microphone arrays, MEMS microphones, wireless microphone systems, and recording technology. Includes microphone system architecture, ingress protection, and audio capture pipeline design.

job_categories.name: Audio Software Engineering
job_categories.description: Coding core audio applications, frameworks, and middleware. Roles typically require C++, JUCE, or similar tools to build DAWs, audio engines, audio HALs, drivers, and processing algorithms.

job_categories.name: Music Technology
job_categories.description: Hardware and software design of creative musical tools. Includes synthesizers, guitar pedals, MIDI controllers, drum machines, and virtual instruments.

job_categories.name: Audio Systems
job_categories.description: End-to-end integration, measurement, and tuning of audio subsystems within consumer electronics, wearables, automotive cabins, and smart speakers. Includes acoustic design, system-level performance optimization, audio test plans, and transducer evaluation.

job_categories.name: Automotive Audio
job_categories.description: Integrating, tuning, and optimizing audio systems within vehicle cabins. Roles involve acoustic measurement, infotainment integration, cabin acoustics, and managing unique automotive acoustic constraints.

job_categories.name: Audio DSP & Embedded Firmware
job_categories.description: Algorithmic manipulation of digital audio signals and embedded firmware implementation. Includes designing filters, EQs, compressors, spatial audio, beamforming, noise cancellation, plus ARM/DSP programming, audio HAL, BSP, and real-time embedded Linux audio.

job_categories.name: Audio AI & Machine Learning
job_categories.description: Deep learning and neural networks applied to audio tasks. Includes audio source separation, music information retrieval (MIR), speech recognition, generative audio models, and ML-based audio enhancement.

job_categories.name: Audio Research & Science
job_categories.description: Scientific research advancing the frontiers of audio, acoustics, and perception. Roles involve novel acoustic architectures, spatial audio research, publishing original research, prototyping research hardware, and defining long-term technical direction for audio products.

job_categories.name: Music Production & Recording Arts
job_categories.description: Creative and technical processes of capturing and finalizing music. Includes studio tracking, mixing, mastering, and beat production.

job_categories.name: Live Sound & Event Production
job_categories.description: Real-time audio deployment for concerts, theater, and corporate events. Roles include Front of House (FOH) engineering, monitor mixing, A/V rigging, and system tech.

job_categories.name: NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness)
job_categories.description: Measuring and minimizing unwanted mechanical noise and vibration, prevalent in automotive, aerospace, and industrial manufacturing sectors.

job_categories.name: Psychoacoustics & Audio Perception
job_categories.description: Scientific study of sound perception and human audiology. Roles involve designing listening tests, subjective audio evaluation, HRTF research, and hearing science.

job_categories.name: Game Audio & Interactive Sound
job_categories.description: Creating and implementing non-linear sound for video games and XR environments. Requires proficiency in sound design and interactive middleware like Wwise or FMOD.
